title: PHP 7.4.4 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 7.4.4. This is a bug fix release.

All PHP 7.4 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 7.4.4 please visit our page Windows binaries can be found on the site. The list of changes is recorded in the .downloadsPHP for WindowsChangeLog
author: PHP.net news & announcements
